insight: Abfahrt and Ankunft are the two poles of every German journey — both built from fahren/kommen plus a directional prefix (ab- = away, an- = towards). ⚠ Lookalike alert: Aufenthalt looks like aufhalten (to hold up/detain) — and it is related, but Aufenthalt is always positive: a stay or stopover. Verspätung (delay) is so common on German trains that 'Der Zug hat Verspätung' is almost a national cliché. Fahrkarte = fare card (Fahr- from fahren + Karte = card); Fahrschein is a regional synonym.

words.breakdown_note: Inseparable despite looking separable. Ich wiederhole (no split). Wiederholung = repetition/revision. Contrast: wiederholen (inseparable, to repeat) vs. wieder holen (separable, to fetch again).

examples.en: Could you please repeat that?

examples.de: Wir wiederholen den Stoff vor der Prüfung.
examples.en: We revise the material before the exam.

words.mnemonic: You are fetching (holen) the same idea again (wieder) — repeating it.

words.breakdown_note: Äußerung = a single spoken or written statement. Äußern = to express. Sich äußern zu = to comment on something. Meinungsäußerung = expression of opinion.

examples.en: His remark surprised everyone.
That was a careless statement.

words.mnemonic: äußer- = outer → you push thoughts outward into words.

words.breakdown_note: ankündigen = announce something in advance. Contrast: kündigen = to terminate a contract. Ankündigung = announcement. Root kund appears in Auskunft, erkundigen.

conjugation.imperative: du: Kündige an!  ·  Sie: Kündigen Sie an!

examples.de: Die Regierung hat neue Maßnahmen angekündigt.
examples.en: The government announced new measures.
He gave notice of his visit.

words.grammar_notes: Separable: kündigt … an. Announcement is always future-oriented.
words.mnemonic: You make something kund (known) before it happens.

words.breakdown_note: A written or spoken side-note. Anmerkungen machen = to take notes/annotate. More formal than Notiz.

examples.de: Der Lehrer machte eine kurze Anmerkung.
examples.en: The teacher made a brief note.
The book contains helpful annotations.

words.mnemonic: You mark (merken) something an (on) the side.

words.breakdown_note: Sich ausdrücken = to express oneself. Ausdruck = expression. Ausdrucksweise = manner of expression. Also literal: eine Zitrone ausdrücken = to squeeze a lemon.

examples.de: Er kann seine Gefühle kaum ausdrücken.
examples.en: He can barely express his feelings.

examples.de: Sie drückt sich sehr klar aus.
examples.en: She expresses herself very clearly.

words.grammar_notes: Reflexive form (sich ausdrücken) is very common.
words.mnemonic: You press (drücken) thoughts out (aus) into words.

words.breakdown_note: Official/public announcement. Stronger and more formal than sagen. Bekanntgabe = the act of announcing (noun).

examples.en: The result was officially announced.

examples.de: Die Firma gibt ihre Entscheidung morgen bekannt.
examples.en: The company will announce its decision tomorrow.

words.mnemonic: You give (geben) something into the known (bekannt) world.

words.breakdown_note: Formal word for informing someone of something. Benachrichtigung = notification. Less formal alternatives: informieren, mitteilen, Bescheid geben.

examples.en: Please notify us immediately.

examples.de: Er wurde über den Unfall benachrichtigt.
examples.en: He was notified about the accident.

words.mnemonic: You send a Nachricht (message) to someone — be- makes it causative.

words.breakdown_note: Etwas besprechen = to discuss something. Besprechung = meeting/discussion. Inseparable.

examples.en: We need to discuss the problem.
The topic was discussed in detail.

words.mnemonic: be- intensifies: you speak (sprechen) through something thoroughly.

insight: Buchen originally meant to write in a book (Buch) — hence 'to book/reserve'. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Unterkunft looks like Ankunft (arrival) — both end in -kunft (from kommen). Unterkunft = shelter-coming (where you come to stay); Ankunft = the coming-to-a-place. Übernachten = to stay overnight: über (over/across) + Nacht (night). Note: abfahren (train departs), abfliegen (plane takes off), ablegen (ship sets sail) — each transport type uses a different verb.

words.breakdown_note: Eine Besprechung haben/abhalten = to have/hold a meeting. Also: a written review (of a book or film).

examples.en: The meeting lasts one hour.

examples.de: Er schreibt eine Besprechung des neuen Romans.
examples.en: He is writing a review of the new novel.

words.breakdown_note: Betonen = to stress a syllable OR to emphasise a point. Betonung = stress/emphasis.

examples.de: Sie betonte die Wichtigkeit des Projekts.
examples.en: She emphasised the importance of the project.

examples.de: Das Wort wird auf der ersten Silbe betont.
examples.en: The word is stressed on the first syllable.

words.mnemonic: You put a Ton (tone) on something — be- makes it causative.

words.breakdown_note: Etwas erwähnen = to mention, bring up briefly. Erwähnenswert = worth mentioning.

examples.de: Er hat das Problem beiläufig erwähnt.
examples.en: He mentioned the problem in passing.

examples.de: Das wurde im Bericht nicht erwähnt.
examples.en: That was not mentioned in the report.

words.mnemonic: To er- (bring about) a fleeting mention — a raising of words.

words.breakdown_note: Im Flüsterton = in a whisper. Geflüster = whispering (collective). Contrast: murmeln (to murmur), raunen (to whisper mysteriously).

examples.de: Sie flüsterte ihm etwas ins Ohr.
examples.en: She whispered something in his ear.
There was whispering in the audience.

words.mnemonic: The fl- sound feels like a soft breath — just like whispering.

words.breakdown_note: Ich möchte noch hinzufügen, dass … = I would like to add that … Common in formal speech and writing.

examples.en: I would like to add something.
Add your name.

words.mnemonic: hinzu = in addition; fügen = to join — you join something extra on.

words.breakdown_note: Low, indistinct sound — for people and water alike. Contrast: flüstern (intentional whisper), raunen (mysterious).

examples.en: He mumbled something incomprehensible.
The brook murmurs softly.

words.mnemonic: Onomatopoeic — mur-mur, the sound of low rumbling voices.

words.breakdown_note: Mündliche Prüfung = oral exam. Antonym: schriftlich (written).

examples.en: The exam is oral.
That was only agreed verbally.

words.mnemonic: Mund = mouth → mündlich = coming from the mouth = spoken.

words.breakdown_note: Richer than beschreiben — it paints a picture with words. Schilderung = description/account.

examples.de: Er schilderte den Unfall sehr genau.
examples.en: He described the accident very precisely.
She depicted her journey vividly.

words.mnemonic: A Schild (sign/picture) tells you what something is — to schildern is to paint a verbal picture.

words.breakdown_note: A vivid account or portrayal. Eine ausführliche Schilderung = a detailed account.

examples.de: Seine Schilderung des Ereignisses war bewegend.
examples.en: His account of the event was moving.

words.breakdown_note: Ein Schrei = a single scream. Der letzte Schrei = the latest craze (idiom).

examples.de: Ein lauter Schrei hallte durch das Haus.
examples.en: A loud scream echoed through the house.
That is the latest fashion!

words.mnemonic: Schrei sounds like 'cry' — a sharp, high sound.

insight: Zoll has two completely unrelated meanings: customs/duty AND the unit inch (2.54 cm) — a pure homonym. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Grenze looks nothing like its meaning 'border', because it is a loanword from Polish granica, borrowed in the Middle Ages via trade routes. Ausland vs. Inland: the suffix -land anchors both — Aus- (out) vs. In- (in). ⚠ Lookalike alert: Reiseziel — Ziel means goal/target, so a Reiseziel is literally your journey's goal, not a 'travel seal' (Reisesiegel). Don't confuse Ziel (goal) with Siegel (seal/stamp).

words.breakdown_note: Irregular verb. Schrei = noun. Anschreien = to shout at someone. Aufschreien = to cry out suddenly.

examples.en: The child screamed in pain.
Don't shout so loudly!

words.mnemonic: The -ei sound is sharp and high — like a scream.

words.breakdown_note: Formal or diplomatic conversation. Eine Unterredung führen = to hold talks.

examples.de: Die Unterredung zwischen den Ministern dauerte zwei Stunden.
examples.en: The talks between the ministers lasted two hours.

words.mnemonic: Unter (among) + Rede (speech) — speech that goes back and forth between people.

words.breakdown_note: Einen Termin vereinbaren = to make an appointment. Vereinbarung = agreement/arrangement.

examples.en: We have arranged an appointment.
That was agreed upon.

words.grammar_notes: Often used with a Termin (appointment) or Treffen (meeting).
words.mnemonic: ver- + ein (one) → bring two parties to ONE agreement.

words.breakdown_note: Eine Vereinbarung treffen = to reach an agreement. Laut Vereinbarung = as agreed.

examples.de: Laut Vereinbarung beginnt die Arbeit um 9 Uhr.
examples.en: According to the agreement, work starts at 9 o'clock.

words.breakdown_note: Zur Wiederholung = by way of revision/recap. TV: eine Wiederholung = a repeat/rerun.

examples.de: Zur Wiederholung: Was haben wir gelernt?
examples.en: To recap: what did we learn?
The film is showing as a repeat.

words.breakdown_note: Core verb. Schreiben (noun) = letter/writing. Schriftlich = written. Aufschreiben = to note down. Abschreiben = to copy / to write off.

examples.de: Sie schreibt einen Brief an ihre Mutter.
examples.en: She is writing a letter to her mother.
How do you write/spell that?

words.mnemonic: schreib- sounds like 'scribe' — a writer.

insight: Abflug (takeoff) vs. Landung (landing): note the asymmetry — Abflug uses ab- (away) + Flug (flight), while Landung comes from landen + -ung. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Staatsangehörigkeit contains angehören (to belong to), not gehören (to belong/be owned). angehören + Dative = to be a member of; gehören + Dative = to belong to someone as property. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Gepäckaufgabe — Aufgabe normally means 'task' or 'homework', but here it means 'surrender/hand-over'. Gepäck aufgeben = to check in your luggage (hand it over).

words.breakdown_note: Three meanings: (1) handwriting, (2) a writing system (die lateinische Schrift), (3) a publication (eine wissenschaftliche Schrift). Schriftlich = written (adjective).

examples.de: Ich kann seine Schrift kaum lesen.
examples.en: I can barely read his handwriting.
The document is available in writing.

words.mnemonic: Schrift = what you get when you schreiben (write).

words.breakdown_note: A small piece of paper with something written on it. Notizzettel = notepad slip. Spickzettel = cheat sheet.

examples.de: Er hat mir einen Zettel hinterlassen.
examples.en: He left me a note.
Write it on a slip of paper!

words.mnemonic: A Zettel is a little scrap — a jotted note.

words.breakdown_note: Literally 'lead pin' — though modern pencils use graphite, the name stuck. Bleistiftzeichnung = pencil drawing.

examples.en: Write that in pencil first.
Do you have a pencil with you?

words.mnemonic: Blei (lead) + Stift (stick/pen) = a lead-stick = pencil.

words.breakdown_note: Used for official text: Die Regel lautet … = The rule reads/goes … Not interchangeable with lesen — lauten is impersonal for texts.

examples.de: Die Frage lautet: Was ist Glück?
examples.en: The question reads: What is happiness?
The order was: Stay still!

words.grammar_notes: Subject is always a text/rule/order, never a person.
words.mnemonic: What the text 'sounds like' (Laut) when spoken — lauten.

words.breakdown_note: Literally 'correct writing'. Rechtschreibfehler = spelling mistake. Die neue Rechtschreibung = the reformed spelling (1996 reform). Always singular.

examples.en: His text has many spelling mistakes.

examples.de: Die Rechtschreibung wird in der Schule geübt.
examples.en: Spelling is practised at school.

words.mnemonic: recht (right) + Schreibung (writing) = writing it right = spelling.

words.breakdown_note: Schriftlich = in writing (form). Antonym: mündlich (oral). Bitte schriftlich bestätigen = please confirm in writing.

examples.en: That must be recorded in writing.
I need written confirmation.

words.breakdown_note: Sein Schrift ist unlesbar = his handwriting is illegible. Synonym: unleserlich (especially for handwriting).

examples.de: Die Schrift auf dem alten Dokument ist unlesbar.
examples.en: The writing on the old document is illegible.
I find this book unreadable.

insight: Nachricht vs. Mitteilung: both mean 'message', but Nachricht is informal/everyday (a news item, a WhatsApp); Mitteilung is formal (an official notification). ⚠ Lookalike alert: Gespräch ends in -sprach (speech), like Sprache (language) and sprechen (to speak) — all share the same root. The ge- prefix creates a collective noun: all the back-and-forth speaking. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Austausch looks like Tausch (swap), because it IS from tauschen — aus- means both sides swap something OUT. Don't confuse with Auslass (outlet) or Ausnahme (exception).

words.breakdown_note: Literally 'a coming-out (of information)'. Auskunft geben = to give information. Root kund- also in ankündigen, erkundigen.

examples.en: Can you give me some information?
I called the information desk.

words.mnemonic: Information 'comes out' (aus + kommen/Kunft) toward you.

words.breakdown_note: Über etw. berichten = to report on something. Bericht = report. Berichterstatter = reporter/correspondent.

examples.de: Der Journalist berichtet über den Konflikt.
examples.en: The journalist is reporting on the conflict.
She reported on her trip.

words.grammar_notes: Takes über + Acc when specifying topic.
words.mnemonic: be- + richten (to set straight) → to set the facts straight = to report.

words.breakdown_note: Beschreibe, wie … = describe how … Beschreibung = description.

examples.en: Can you describe the man?

examples.de: Sie beschrieb den Weg sehr genau.
examples.en: She described the route very precisely.

words.mnemonic: be- + schreiben (write) → write something 'all over' with detail.

words.breakdown_note: Eine genaue Beschreibung = an accurate description. Stellenbeschreibung = job description.

examples.de: Die Beschreibung des Täters stimmte genau.
examples.en: The description of the perpetrator was accurate.

words.breakdown_note: Two uses: (1) to explain (etwas erklären), (2) to declare formally (den Krieg erklären). Erklärung = explanation or declaration.

examples.en: Can you explain that to me?
He declared his resignation.

words.mnemonic: er- brings something to clarity (klar) — to make clear = to explain.

words.breakdown_note: Dafür gibt es keine Erklärung = there is no explanation for that. Eine Erklärung abgeben = to make a declaration.

examples.de: Sie gab eine offizielle Erklärung ab.
examples.en: She issued an official declaration.
I need an explanation for that.

words.breakdown_note: Informationen einholen = to gather information. Zur Information = for your information (FYI).

examples.de: Weitere Informationen finden Sie auf unserer Website.
examples.en: Further information can be found on our website.

insight: ⚠ Key lookalike: erkundigen looks like Kunde (customer) — but they are NOT related. erkundigen comes from kund (known/announced, archaic), the same root as ankündigen (to announce) and Auskunft (information). Sich erkundigen = to make something known to yourself by asking. Kunde (customer) comes from a completely different root (kennen → Bekanntschaft). ⚠ Also: beantworten vs. antworten — beantworten takes a DIRECT object (eine Frage beantworten), while antworten uses auf + Accusative (auf eine Frage antworten). Never say *auf eine Frage beantworten.

words.breakdown_note: Sich informieren über + Acc = to find out about. Gut informiert = well-informed.

examples.de: Ich habe ihn über die Situation informiert.
examples.en: I informed him about the situation.
Please inform yourself beforehand.

words.mnemonic: To put someone 'into form' about a situation = to inform.

words.english: to be going on / to be the matter
words.breakdown_note: Was ist los? = What's going on? / What's wrong? Hier ist viel los = There's a lot happening here. Very common colloquially.

examples.en: What's going on here?
Something is the matter with him.

words.grammar_notes: Was ist los? is one of the most common expressions in spoken German.
words.mnemonic: los = let loose → what's been let loose? = what's going on?

words.breakdown_note: Sich melden = to report in / to get in touch. Anmelden = to register. Abmelden = to deregister. Meldung = report.

examples.en: Get in touch soon!

examples.de: Er hat den Diebstahl bei der Polizei gemeldet.
examples.en: He reported the theft to the police.

words.mnemonic: To send a signal (herald) → to report/make yourself known.

words.breakdown_note: Eine Nachricht hinterlassen = to leave a message. Die Nachrichten = the news (always plural for TV/radio news). Benachrichtigen = to notify (verb derived from this noun).

examples.en: Did you get my message?

examples.de: Wir hören die Nachrichten um 20 Uhr.
examples.en: We watch the news at 8 pm.

words.mnemonic: A Nachricht follows (nach) you — it comes after you to reach you.

words.breakdown_note: Usually plural: Neuigkeiten = news (informal, personal). Contrast: Nachricht = specific message; Nachrichten = broadcast news; Neuigkeit = something new and surprising, often personal.

examples.de: Hast du die neueste Neuigkeit gehört?
examples.en: Have you heard the latest news?

examples.de: Ich habe keine Neuigkeiten von ihr.
examples.en: I have no news from her.

words.mnemonic: Neues = something new → Neuigkeit = a fresh, new piece of news.

words.breakdown_note: Two plurals, two meanings: Ratschläge = pieces of advice; Räte = councils (political, e.g. Stadtrat = city council). Rat geben = to give advice.

examples.de: Kannst du mir einen Rat geben?
examples.en: Can you give me a piece of advice?
He sits on the city council.

words.mnemonic: Rat sounds like 'rate' — to assess what someone should do.

words.breakdown_note: Two meanings: (1) jemandem raten = to advise, (2) raten = to guess (Rate mal! = Guess!). Ich rate dir, vorsichtig zu sein = I advise you to be careful.

examples.en: I advise you to get up early.
Guess who called!

words.grammar_notes: When advising: raten + Dative person + zu + infinitive.
words.mnemonic: raten covers both advice and guessing — both involve reasoning toward an answer.

words.breakdown_note: Auf etwas zeigen = to point at something. Es zeigt sich, dass … = it turns out that …

examples.de: Kannst du mir zeigen, wie das geht?
examples.en: Can you show me how that works?
He pointed at the board.

words.mnemonic: zeigen → the Zeigefinger (index finger) is literally the 'showing finger'.

insight: ⚠ Lookalike pair: Arbeitgeber vs. Arbeitnehmer are a perfect logical mirror — who GIVES work (geben) vs. who TAKES work (nehmen). Bewerbung / bewerben come from werben (to advertise/recruit) — you are advertising yourself. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Gehalt has two meanings — salary AND content/substance (der Gehalt = the content, e.g. Alkoholgehalt = alcohol content). The salary meaning uses das Gehalt; the content meaning uses der Gehalt — gender marks the difference.

words.breakdown_note: ⚠ Grammar trap: beantworten takes a DIRECT object — eine Frage beantworten. Antworten uses auf + Acc — auf eine Frage antworten. NEVER: *auf eine Frage beantworten.

examples.en: Can you answer my question?
The email was not answered.

words.grammar_notes: beantworten + direct Acc vs. antworten + auf + Acc.
words.mnemonic: be- wraps around the Antwort to make it a direct-object verb.

words.breakdown_note: Jemanden beraten = to advise someone. Sich beraten = to consult each other. Beratung = counselling/consultation.

examples.en: The doctor advises the patient.
We consulted extensively.

words.mnemonic: be- intensifies raten → to give thorough, professional advice.

words.breakdown_note: Jemandem Bescheid geben/sagen = to let someone know. Bescheid wissen = to be in the know. Behörden: einen Bescheid erhalten = to receive an official ruling.

examples.de: Gib mir bitte Bescheid, wenn du ankommst.
examples.en: Please let me know when you arrive.
He knows everything / is in the know.

words.grammar_notes: Bescheid geben/sagen + Dative: Sag mir Bescheid.
words.mnemonic: Bescheid = the answer that 'divides' uncertainty — you now know.

words.breakdown_note: ⚠ Lookalike: erkundigen looks like Kunde (customer) but NOT related. Comes from kund (to make known) = same root as ankündigen, Auskunft. Sich erkundigen nach + Dative = to inquire about.

examples.de: Ich habe mich nach den Preisen erkundigt.
examples.en: I inquired about the prices.

examples.de: Darf ich mich erkundigen, wer Sie sind?
examples.en: May I inquire who you are?

words.grammar_notes: Always reflexive. Takes nach + Dative for the topic.
words.mnemonic: You make something kund (known) to yourself by asking = to inquire.

words.breakdown_note: Everyday word for practical advice. Tipps und Tricks = tips and tricks. More casual than Rat or Ratschlag.

examples.de: Hast du einen Tipp für mich?
examples.en: Do you have a tip for me?
That is a good tip!

words.mnemonic: English loanword: tip → der Tipp. The extra -p is German doubling convention.

words.breakdown_note: Two meanings: (1) to teach (Schüler unterrichten), (2) to inform officially (jemanden über etw. unterrichten). Unterricht = lesson/instruction (noun).

examples.de: Sie unterrichtet Mathematik an einer Schule.
examples.en: She teaches maths at a school.

examples.de: Er wurde über die Lage unterrichtet.
examples.en: He was informed about the situation.

words.mnemonic: unter (under) + richten (to direct) → to direct from below = to instruct.

words.english: to betray / to reveal / to give away
words.breakdown_note: Two meanings: (1) to betray (ein Geheimnis verraten = to give away a secret), (2) to reveal casually (Kannst du mir verraten, wo …?). Verrat = treason/betrayal.

examples.en: He gave away the secret.

examples.de: Kannst du mir verraten, wie das geht?
examples.en: Can you let me in on how that works?

words.mnemonic: ver- twists raten (counsel) into bad counsel = to betray.

insight: ⚠ Key lookalike: einstellen has two opposite meanings — (1) to HIRE someone (jemanden einstellen = to place someone into the company); (2) to STOP or ADJUST something (die Produktion einstellen = to halt production; den Sender einstellen = to tune the radio). Context is essential. ⚠ Lookalike alert: kündigen vs. ankündigen — kündigen ends a contract; ankündigen announces something in the future. They share the root kund (to make known) but mean opposite things.

words.breakdown_note: Two tones: (1) concession (Das stimmt allerdings nicht = that is not correct, however); (2) emphatic agreement (Allerdings! = Indeed! / Absolutely!).

examples.de: Das Essen war gut, allerdings etwas teuer.
examples.en: The food was good, though a bit expensive.
'Did you do that?' – 'Indeed I did!'

words.mnemonic: aller + dings = of all things — used to introduce the real point.

words.breakdown_note: Always paired with einerseits … andererseits = on the one hand … on the other hand.

examples.de: Einerseits ist es billig, andererseits von schlechter Qualität.
examples.en: On the one hand it's cheap, on the other hand it's poor quality.

words.mnemonic: anderer (other) + seits (sides) = on the other side of the argument.

words.breakdown_note: Meiner Ansicht nach = in my view. Also visual: die Ansicht eines Gebäudes = a view of a building. Ansichtskarte = picture postcard.

examples.de: Meiner Ansicht nach hat er Recht.
examples.en: In my view, he is right.
We have different views.

words.mnemonic: An-sicht = what you see when looking at something = your view.

words.breakdown_note: Etw. begründen = to give reasons for, to justify. Begründung = justification. Gut begründet = well-founded.

examples.en: Please justify your answer.
He gave detailed reasons for his decision.

words.mnemonic: be- + Grund (ground/reason) → to give something a ground = to justify.

words.breakdown_note: Eine Begründung liefern = to provide a reason. Ohne Begründung = without justification.

examples.de: Die Begründung für die Entscheidung war unklar.
examples.en: The reason given for the decision was unclear.

words.breakdown_note: Jemanden/etwas beurteilen = to assess neutrally. Beurteilung = assessment/appraisal. More neutral than verurteilen (to condemn).

examples.de: Man kann eine Person nicht so schnell beurteilen.
examples.en: You cannot assess a person so quickly.

examples.de: Die Lage ist schwer zu beurteilen.
examples.en: The situation is difficult to assess.

words.mnemonic: be- + Urteil (judgement) → to form a judgement on something.

words.breakdown_note: Eine Diskussion führen = to hold a discussion. Zur Diskussion stellen = to put up for discussion.

examples.en: The discussion was lively.
That is not up for discussion.

words.breakdown_note: Always paired with andererseits. Introduces the first of two contrasting points.

examples.de: Einerseits will ich reisen, andererseits habe ich kein Geld.
examples.en: On the one hand I want to travel, on the other hand I have no money.

insight: Beruf vs. Job vs. Tätigkeit: Beruf is your vocation (lifelong identity); Job is casual/colloquial; Tätigkeit is the formal bureaucratic word used on official forms. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Lebenslauf — Lauf means run/course (not 'leaf'/Blatt), so this is literally the 'course of your life', not a 'life leaf'. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Fachmann contains Fach (subject/compartment), not Fach as in Bach/Dach — it's the same Fach as in Schulfach (school subject) or Fachgebiet (field of expertise).

words.breakdown_note: Inseparable, vowel change: empfiehlt (3rd sg present). Empfehlung = recommendation. Empfehlungsschreiben = letter of recommendation.

examples.en: I highly recommend this restaurant.
What would you recommend?

words.mnemonic: emp- sounds like 'impress' — you impress the idea on someone (recommend it).

words.breakdown_note: Separable. Ich stelle fest, dass … = I note/find that … Feststellung = finding/observation.

examples.de: Ich stelle fest, dass die Daten falsch sind.
examples.en: I note that the data is wrong.

examples.de: Es wurde festgestellt, dass er log.
examples.en: It was established that he lied.

words.mnemonic: fest (fixed) + stellen (place) → to fix/establish a fact.

words.english: to think / mean / be of the opinion
words.breakdown_note: Was meinen Sie dazu? = What do you think about it? Contrast: bedeuten = a word's meaning; meinen = to mean/intend or to hold an opinion. Gut gemeint = well-intentioned.

examples.en: What do you mean by that?
I think we should wait.

words.mnemonic: mein (my) + en → to express MY opinion.

words.breakdown_note: Meiner Meinung nach = in my opinion (abbrev. MMn). Meinungsfreiheit = freedom of opinion/speech. Jemandem die Meinung sagen = to give someone a piece of your mind.

examples.de: Meiner Meinung nach ist das falsch.
examples.en: In my opinion that is wrong.
We have different opinions.

words.breakdown_note: Einen Standpunkt vertreten = to hold a standpoint. Von meinem Standpunkt aus = from my point of view.

examples.en: They hold different standpoints.

examples.de: Von meinem Standpunkt aus ist das falsch.
examples.en: From my point of view, that is wrong.

words.mnemonic: The point (Punkt) where you stand (Stand) = your fixed position/view.

words.breakdown_note: Jemanden überreden = to talk someone into something despite reluctance. Contrast: überzeugen (to convince rationally).

examples.en: He talked me into coming along.

examples.de: Lass dich nicht so leicht überreden!
examples.en: Don't let yourself be talked into things so easily!

words.mnemonic: über (over) + reden (talk) → to talk OVER someone's objections.

words.breakdown_note: Jemanden von etw. überzeugen = to convince with evidence/logic. Sich überzeugen = to verify/satisfy oneself. Contrast: überreden (talk into) vs. überzeugen (convince rationally). Überzeugend = convincing.

examples.de: Er hat mich von seiner Idee überzeugt.
examples.en: He convinced me of his idea.

examples.de: Der Film hat mich nicht überzeugt.
examples.en: The film did not convince me.

words.mnemonic: über + zeugen (witness) → to give witness beyond doubt = to convince.

insight: Kenntnisse is almost always plural — you rarely have a single Kenntnis. On CVs: Kenntnisse (knowledge areas), Fähigkeiten (abilities), Fertigkeiten (practical skills) — German CV language uses all three with subtle differences. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Beförderung means both PROMOTION at work and TRANSPORTATION/CONVEYANCE (Beförderungsmittel = means of transport). Same word, very different contexts. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Ausbildung vs. Fortbildung vs. Weiterbildung — Ausbildung = initial vocational training; Fortbildung = advancing existing skills; Weiterbildung = any further education.

words.breakdown_note: Das Wesentliche = the essential thing. Wesentlich besser = significantly better (adverbial use very common). Im Wesentlichen = essentially.

examples.en: That is significantly more important.
Essentially, he is right.

words.mnemonic: Wesen (essence) + -lich = relating to the essence = essential.

words.breakdown_note: Ein Argument vorbringen/anführen = to put forward an argument. Gegenargument = counter-argument.

examples.en: That is a strong argument.
I have no more arguments.

words.breakdown_note: Meiner Auffassung nach = in my understanding/view. More intellectual than Meinung. Auffassungsgabe = ability to grasp things quickly.

examples.de: Meiner Auffassung nach ist das nicht korrekt.
examples.en: In my view, that is not correct.

examples.de: Sie haben unterschiedliche Auffassungen vom Leben.
examples.en: They have different conceptions of life.

words.mnemonic: auf + fassen (grasp) = how you grasp something = your conception.

words.breakdown_note: Als etw. bezeichnen = to call/describe something as. Bezeichnung = designation/label/term. Bezeichnend = characteristic/telling.

examples.en: He is referred to as an expert.
That is very telling/characteristic.

words.mnemonic: be- + Zeichen (sign/mark) → to put a sign on something = to label.

words.breakdown_note: Über etw. diskutieren = to discuss something. Diskussion = discussion (noun).

examples.en: We discussed for hours.

examples.de: Das Thema wird in der Presse diskutiert.
examples.en: The topic is being debated in the press.

words.breakdown_note: ⚠ Three meanings: (1) attitude (eine positive Einstellung), (2) hiring (die Einstellung neuer Mitarbeiter), (3) setting/adjustment (die Einstellung des Radios). Context is essential.

examples.de: Er hat eine negative Einstellung zur Arbeit.
examples.en: He has a negative attitude to work.

examples.de: Die Einstellung von Fachkräften ist schwierig.
examples.en: The hiring of skilled workers is difficult.

words.mnemonic: Ein-stellen = to place into position → your stance = your Einstellung.

words.english: to a certain extent / in a way / so to speak
words.breakdown_note: A hedging adverb, similar to sozusagen. Das ist gewissermaßen richtig = That is, to a certain extent, correct.

examples.de: Er ist gewissermaßen der Chef hier.
examples.en: He is, in a way, the boss here.
That was, to a certain extent, my fault.

words.mnemonic: gewiss (certain) + Maßen (measures) = to a certain measure = to some extent.

words.english: anyway / in any case / as it is
words.breakdown_note: Das wäre ohnehin passiert = that would have happened anyway. Synonyms: sowieso, eh (colloquial).

examples.en: He will be late anyway.
I know that anyway.

words.mnemonic: ohne (without) + hin (away) → without going anywhere = anyway, regardless.

words.breakdown_note: Bleiben Sie sachlich! = Stick to the facts! / Stay objective! Antonym: emotional, persönlich.

examples.en: Please remain objective.
He gave a matter-of-fact answer.

words.mnemonic: Sache (matter/fact) + -lich = sticking to the facts = objective.

insight: Gemeinschaft vs. Gesellschaft is one of sociology's founding distinctions (Ferdinand Tönnies, 1887): Gemeinschaft = warm personal community bonds; Gesellschaft = formal contractual society. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Behörde (authority/government office) looks like gehören (to belong) — but Behörde comes from hören (to hear/obey) via Old High German: an authority is one that is 'listened to'. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Amt means a public office/position, not 'amount'. Bürger originally meant town-dweller (Burg = fortified town); now it means citizen.

words.breakdown_note: Selbstverständlich! = Of course! Das ist selbstverständlich = that goes without saying.

examples.en: Of course I'll help you.
That goes without saying.

words.mnemonic: selbst (self) + verständlich (understandable) = understandable by itself = obvious.

words.breakdown_note: Very common colloquial synonym of ohnehin. Das wäre sowieso passiert = that would have happened anyway.

examples.en: I would have done that anyway.
He won't come anyway.

words.mnemonic: so wie so = it's like this (so) just like that (so) = anyway.

words.english: so to speak / as it were
words.breakdown_note: A hedging expression that qualifies a statement as approximate. Equivalent to 'as it were' or 'in a manner of speaking'.

examples.en: He is, so to speak, our leader.
That was, as it were, the end.

words.mnemonic: so zu sagen = so to say = so to speak. Almost a literal translation!

words.breakdown_note: Eine Stellungnahme abgeben = to make/issue a statement. Official and formal. Used in law, journalism, politics.

examples.de: Die Ministerin gab eine Stellungnahme ab.
examples.en: The minister issued a statement.
I ask for your position/comment.

words.mnemonic: You take (nehmen) a position (Stellung) — Stellungnahme = the act of taking a stance.

words.breakdown_note: Aus Überzeugung = out of conviction. Meiner Überzeugung nach = in my conviction. Starke Überzeugungen = strong convictions.

examples.en: He acts out of deep conviction.
That is my firm conviction.

words.breakdown_note: Etwas Unerwartetes = something unexpected. Root: erwarten (to expect).

examples.en: The result was completely unexpected.
He came home unexpectedly.

words.mnemonic: un- + erwartet (expected) = not expected = unexpected.

words.breakdown_note: Das ist ungewöhnlich = that is unusual. Ungewöhnlich gut = remarkably good (adverbial use). Root: Gewohnheit (habit).

examples.de: Das Wetter ist für diese Jahreszeit ungewöhnlich.
examples.en: The weather is unusual for this time of year.
She is unusually clever.

words.breakdown_note: Two meanings: (1) legal verdict (das Urteil sprechen), (2) personal judgement (sich ein Urteil bilden = to form an opinion). Verurteilen = to condemn. Vorurteil = prejudice.

examples.en: The court pronounced the verdict.

examples.de: Ich kann mir kein Urteil darüber erlauben.
examples.en: I am not in a position to judge that.

words.mnemonic: ur- (original) + Teil (part/share) → the original share of truth = judgement.

words.breakdown_note: Zu zwei Jahren verurteilen = to sentence to two years. Moralisch verurteilen = to condemn morally. Contrast: beurteilen (neutral) vs. verurteilen (condemn).

examples.de: Er wurde zu fünf Jahren Haft verurteilt.
examples.en: He was sentenced to five years in prison.

examples.de: Man sollte andere nicht so schnell verurteilen.
examples.en: One should not condemn others so quickly.

insight: ⚠ Key lookalike: Wahl means BOTH election AND choice — 'Ich habe keine Wahl' (I have no choice) vs. 'die Bundestagswahl' (federal election). ⚠ Triple meaning: Recht = (1) the right (das Recht auf Bildung = the right to education); (2) the law (das Recht sprechen = to administer justice); (3) recht as adverb = quite/rather (recht gut = quite good; recht haben = to be right). Pflicht pairs with Recht: 'Rechte und Pflichten' (rights and duties) is a fixed pairing in legal German.

words.breakdown_note: Einen Antrag ablehnen = to reject an application. Ablehnung = rejection. Contrast: annehmen (to accept).

examples.en: The application was rejected.
I refuse that / I reject it.

words.mnemonic: ab (away) + lehnen (lean) → lean away from = reject.

words.breakdown_note: Eine Ablehnung erhalten = to receive a rejection. Auf Ablehnung stoßen = to meet with rejection.

examples.de: Sie erhielt eine Ablehnung von der Universität.
examples.en: She received a rejection from the university.

words.breakdown_note: Almost always plural: Bedenken haben = to have reservations. Ohne Bedenken = without reservations. Bedenken äußern = to express concerns.

examples.en: I have serious reservations.
He did it without hesitation.

words.breakdown_note: Eine Beschwerde einlegen = to lodge a complaint (official). Also medical: Beschwerden = symptoms/ailments (always plural).

examples.en: He filed a complaint.
Do you have any physical symptoms?

words.breakdown_note: Sich beschweren über + Acc = to complain about. Bei jemandem beschweren = to complain to someone.

examples.de: Er beschwert sich ständig über den Lärm.
examples.en: He constantly complains about the noise.

examples.de: Sie hat sich beim Manager beschwert.
examples.en: She complained to the manager.

words.mnemonic: be- + schwer (heavy) → to make something heavy on you = to complain.

words.breakdown_note: Formal adversative: despite what was said, still/nevertheless. Often interchangeable with trotzdem, but slightly more literary.

examples.de: Es war schwer, dennoch hat er es geschafft.
examples.en: It was difficult, nevertheless he managed it.

examples.de: Sie wusste es, glaubte es dennoch nicht.
examples.en: She knew it, yet still did not believe it.

words.mnemonic: denn (then/for) + noch (still) = still, for all that = nevertheless.

words.english: but / yet / after all / yes (contradicting a negative)
words.breakdown_note: Key uses: (1) contradict a negative: 'Du kommst nicht.' 'Doch!' = 'You're not coming.' 'Yes I am!' (2) adversative: Es ist kalt, doch schön = it's cold, but beautiful. (3) softening: Komm doch herein! = Do come in! (4) reassurance: Das weißt du doch = you know that, don't you.

examples.en: 'Didn't you do it?' – 'Yes I did!'
It is cold, but sunny.

words.grammar_notes: Doch as contradiction to a negative is unique to German — English has no single equivalent.
words.mnemonic: doch is the word that pushes back — it contradicts and asserts.

insight: Nachrichten is always plural for 'the news': die Nachrichten schauen/hören. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Rundfunk contains Funk (radio signal), not Funke (spark) — though both come from the same root. Rund (round/all-around) + Funk = signals sent in all directions. ⚠ Lookalike alert: Sender (broadcaster/channel) and senden (to send/broadcast) share the root, but Sender also means 'transmitter' technically. Don't confuse with absender (sender of a letter). Schlagzeile = headline: Schlag (blow/strike) + Zeile (line) — a line that hits you.

words.english: it doesn't matter / equal / the same
words.breakdown_note: Das ist mir egal = I don't care / it doesn't matter to me. Egal ob … oder … = regardless of whether … or … Extremely common colloquially.

examples.en: I really don't care about that.
No matter what happens, I'm staying.

words.mnemonic: French égal = equal → in German: all equal to me = I don't care.

words.breakdown_note: Sich einig sein = to be in agreement. Wir sind uns einig = we agree. Einigkeit = unity/agreement.

examples.de: Wir sind uns in diesem Punkt einig.
examples.en: We agree on this point.
Everyone was in agreement.

words.mnemonic: einig = one-ish → to be one in thought = to agree.

words.breakdown_note: Einverstanden! = Agreed! / OK! Mit etw. einverstanden sein = to agree to something.

examples.en: Agreed, we'll do it that way.

examples.de: Ich bin mit dem Plan einverstanden.
examples.en: I agree with the plan.

words.mnemonic: ein (in) + verstanden (understood) → understood and in = agreed.

words.breakdown_note: Das ist falsch = that is wrong. Falsch singen = to sing out of tune. Falsch verbunden = wrong number (phone). Contrast: unrichtig (formally incorrect); unwahr (untrue).

examples.en: That is completely wrong.
You made the wrong decision.

words.mnemonic: falsch sounds like 'false' — false = wrong.

words.breakdown_note: Key meanings: (1) against (dafür oder dagegen), (2) approximately (gegen 8 Uhr = around 8 o'clock), (3) in exchange for (gegen Bezahlung). Always takes Accusative.

examples.en: I'm against it.
He arrived around evening.

words.grammar_notes: Takes Accusative. Dafür vs. dagegen = for vs. against it.
words.mnemonic: gegen = against — it pushes back.

words.english: yes / (discourse particle: you know / after all)
words.breakdown_note: Beyond 'yes', ja functions as a modal particle: Du weißt ja = you know, after all. Das ist ja toll! = That is really great! (emphasis).

examples.en: Yes, I'm coming.
That is quite/really interesting!

words.grammar_notes: As a modal particle, ja expresses obviousness, surprise, or reminder.
words.mnemonic: Universal: yes in almost every European language has the ja/ye/yes form.

words.breakdown_note: Ich würde lieber … = I would rather … Comparative of gern: gern – lieber – am liebsten. Lass das lieber = you'd better leave that.

examples.en: I'd rather stay at home.
I prefer coffee to tea.

words.mnemonic: lieb (dear) → lieber = dearer → what you hold dearest = what you prefer.

words.english: as far as I'm concerned / fine by me / for my sake
words.breakdown_note: Three meanings: (1) fine by me (Meinetwegen kannst du das tun), (2) for my sake (Tu das nicht meinetwegen), (3) for all I care (Meinetwegen kann er kommen).

examples.en: As far as I'm concerned, we can go.
Don't do that for my sake.

words.mnemonic: mein (my) + wegen (because of) = because of me / for my sake.

words.breakdown_note: The basic word for no. Nein danke = no thank you. Contrast: doch = 'yes' as contradiction to a negative.

examples.en: No, that is not correct.
No thank you, I don't need anything.

words.breakdown_note: Standard negation particle. Position: before element negated, or at end for whole-clause negation. kein/keine negates nouns; nicht negates verbs and adjectives.

examples.en: I don't understand that.
That is not correct.

words.grammar_notes: kein/keine for nouns; nicht for verbs/adjectives/adverbs.

insight: Beitrag (contribution) is a versatile false-friend magnet: ein Beitrag leisten (make a contribution), ein TV-Beitrag (a TV segment/report), ein Mitgliedsbeitrag (membership fee) — three very different meanings, one word. ⚠ Lookalike trio: Freiheit (freedom), Gleichheit (equality), Gerechtigkeit (justice) — these echo Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité. Note: Freiheit ends in -heit; Gleichheit in -heit; Gerechtigkeit in -keit — both -heit and -keit are feminine abstract noun suffixes meaning '-ness/-hood'. ⚠ Meinungsfreiheit = freedom of opinion (Meinung = opinion, not 'mine').

words.breakdown_note: Das ist richtig = that is correct. Richtig gut = really good (colloquial intensifier). Richtigstellen = to correct/set right.

examples.en: That is the correct answer.

examples.de: Er ist richtig gut in Mathe.
examples.en: He is really good at maths.

words.mnemonic: richt- = direction (richten = to align) → pointing in the right direction = correct.

words.breakdown_note: Das macht Sinn / Das ergibt Sinn = that makes sense. Das hat keinen Sinn = there is no point. Im Sinne von = in the sense of. Die Sinne = the senses (sight, hearing, etc.).

examples.en: That makes no sense.
In the sense/spirit of the law.

words.mnemonic: Sinn = what a thought 'sounds like' inside your mind = meaning/sense.

words.breakdown_note: Ich muss das unbedingt sehen = I absolutely must see that. Unbedingt! = Absolutely! The negative of conditional = absolute.

examples.en: You absolutely must try that!
He wants it unconditionally/absolutely.

words.mnemonic: un- (not) + bedingt (conditioned) = unconditioned = absolute = definitely.

words.breakdown_note: ⚠ Double meaning: (1) personal choice (Ich habe keine Wahl = I have no choice), (2) election (die Bundestagswahl). Erste Wahl = first choice / top quality.

examples.en: I have no choice.

examples.de: Die Wahl findet im September statt.
examples.en: The election takes place in September.

words.mnemonic: Wahl covers both 'picking' (choice) and 'balloting' (election).

words.english: to choose / to vote / to dial
words.breakdown_note: Three meanings: (1) to choose, (2) to vote, (3) to dial a number. Wähler = voter.

examples.en: Have you already voted?
She chose the red dress.

words.mnemonic: wählen = the action of Wahl (choice/election).

words.breakdown_note: Jemandem widersprechen = to contradict someone (Dative!). Inseparable. Widerspruch = contradiction/objection.

examples.en: I must contradict you / disagree with you.
The statements contradict each other.

words.mnemonic: wider (against) + sprechen (speak) = to speak against = to contradict.

words.breakdown_note: Etwas zugeben = to admit something. Das muss ich zugeben = I have to admit that. Separable: Er gibt zu, dass er gelogen hat.

examples.de: Er gab zu, dass er einen Fehler gemacht hatte.
examples.en: He admitted that he had made a mistake.
I have to admit that.

words.mnemonic: zu + geben (give) → to give [the truth] towards someone = to admit.

words.breakdown_note: Zustimmung erteilen/geben = to give consent/approval. Antonym: Ablehnung (rejection). Zustimmen (verb) = to agree.

examples.en: The plan met with general approval.

examples.de: Ohne Zustimmung der Eltern geht das nicht.
examples.en: Without parental consent, that is not possible.

words.mnemonic: zu + stimmen (to tune/vote) → to tune in with someone = to agree.
